title: On-Load Briefing Rule
desc: Mandatory briefing read on session load
steps: NAVIGATION: this skill is an entry-point router for session-start behavior, not an always-execute checklist. STOP FORMAT, EVERY FINAL REPLY (owner 2026-10-04): each paragraph is followed by ONE evidence line, wkappbot skill read CORE_SKILL_ID --keep 'a sentence copied from that skill that shares 2 or more words with your paragraph' (or wkappbot file read PATH --keep '...' for CLAUDE.md, REFLEX.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, HANDOFF.md, README.md, SPOKESMAN.md, ROOT.md); read the item and press a like on it first (SCORE CHECK: if like-healing gate blocks, fold one stale step to on-load-howto to open a 15-minute bypass; example: 2026-10-12 on-load was 62/100, folded WHEN-TO-RUN step, rose to 81, like passed); the LAST paragraph starts with Reflex-healing: (the reflex you did not follow, or none followed wrongly) and has its own evidence line; the gate refuses every time until this holds and every refusal prints a ready example. SPEC FIRST (owner 2026-09-25, mandatory for every ROOT): before building or dispatching a sector, the ROOT itself writes the task spec into the owning skill (the -howto of that tool or guard), then builds from that skill; the spokesman only names the task, to save its tokens for hard problems. A spec kept only in a .tmp note or a chat brief gets re-derived differently next time. REMAINING WORK IS NOT A PARKING LOT (owner 2026-09-25): a letter or escalation lists as remaining ONLY what is blocked on an owner decision or is outside your scope; work that is in scope and unblocked is done NOW, and the words next session must never stand in for it (measured: a Sonnet ROOT wrote Next session must and REMAINING for next session over in-scope items from its first report). WHEN: (A) session start or post-compaction, run steps 1+2 below. (B) user sends exactly 'gg' or 'ggg' (case-insensitive, trim whitespace), run the GG TRIGGER step. (C) user says 'handoff' or 'continue from last session', run the HANDOFF step. (D) user is mid-task or sent a casual greeting, do NOT run the full pipeline. HOW: wkappbot skill read on-load-howto for the exact step sequence and commands for each case. WHY: routing correctly avoids wasting tokens on the full pipeline for casual messages and avoids derailing work already in progress. //why:post-compaction confirmed following now-sonnet //why:will follow post-compaction steps 1 and 2-sonnet //why:post-compaction confirmed following on-load steps now-sonnet

MANDATORY SKILL LOADS (session start / post-compaction only): run both -- (1) wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow (2) wkappbot skill read ask-suggest-priority-batching. If either fails: skip step 2, report which skill failed, and ask the user to check wkappbot health. Do NOT proceed with suggest triage if either skill is unreadable. //why:cited in wkhippo reflex defect report //why:cited in wkhippo reflex defect report-haiku

COMPACTION RECOVERY (only after context compaction, not every session start): for full context re-hydration, also run: wkappbot skill read post-compaction-recovery. Skip this step on normal session starts. //why:will follow: compaction recovery only after //why:hint seam lands after compaction recovery //why:hint seam lands after compaction recovery-sonnet //why:will follow: compaction recovery only after-sonnet //why:will follow: live check before report

CHECK SUGGEST BACKLOG (session start / post-compaction only): wkappbot suggest list. Then follow ask-suggest-priority-batching protocol -- MANDATORY, no shortcuts: (1) merge obvious duplicates. (2) fire wkappbot ask gpt --new-session for batch ranking. (3) STOP and wait for GPT response -- do not burn Sonnet tokens while waiting. (4) per actionable item: fire wkappbot ask gpt with ts+title+root-cause BEFORE any code. (5) only after ask responses arrive: brief Opus agent with ask result + fix path. Fatal = command not found / auth failure. Non-fatal = empty list / timeout. Success: Opus agent reports resolved/skipped counts.

GG TRIGGER: if user message is exactly 'gg' or 'ggg' (case-insensitive, trim whitespace -- GG/Gg/ggg all match), locate '## gg Main Workflow' section in project CLAUDE.md and execute every step sequentially without confirmation. Continue on non-fatal step failures; report summary at end. If CLAUDE.md is missing OR has no gg section: stop here and follow step 6 to create it BEFORE executing. Do not re-invoke on-load from within the new section (circular reference).
HANDOFF: if user says 'handoff' or asks to continue from last session, run: wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff -- then follow its steps to find the previous JSONL and extract context.

PROJECT MAIN TASKS -- gg section authoring (run only when step 5 cannot find a gg section): ask the user what the main recurring tasks are, then write '## gg Main Workflow' together in the repo CLAUDE.md. Rules: each step must be an executable shell command or Agent() call -- no vague descriptions. Include a Frequently used skills table (rank/Skill-ID/When). For tag/naming guidance when adding skills to the table, see: wkappbot skill read skill-search-coverage-guide. TEMPLATE (adapt to project): ## gg Main Workflow (MANDATORY when user sends gg or ggg) -- Execute in order: (1) wkappbot skill read on-load (2) wkappbot suggest list (3) Agent(model:opus, prompt:'run wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow first, then triage: <INSERT suggest list output> BUG-AUTO->important->AI-NEWS merge') (4) wkappbot speak triage-done --bg. Skills table: rank1/suggest-workflow/every session, rank2/ask-suggest-priority-batching/every triage.

SKILL INSTALL CHECK: after any skill contribute/edit this session, verify wkappbot skill install was run. Uninstalled skills are invisible to search and other sessions. Pattern: contribute -> install <path> -> read to verify. See skill-contribute-edit for full rule.

UNCLEAR TERM RULE (owner 2026-09-29, sharpened from the bare-Korean-keyword rule): whenever the owner uses a term you are not certain of -- an isolated Korean keyword, a domain word such as 매수누수, a tool or rule name -- run wkappbot skill search TERM FIRST (bare, no --budget), then a web search if the term is general, BEFORE you interpret or answer. Never guess intent. Measured 2026-09-29: an Opus spokesman guessed the meaning of 매수누수 twice (order flood, pending-book holes) and was corrected by the owner; the definition was one search away. //why:777 band found only by searching 0.77 //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner-haiku //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner-opus //why:777 band found only by searching 0.77-opus //why:777 term searched literally, missed 0.77

NAVIGATION. Execution details (commands, mandatory loads, agent rules, file-edit discipline, skill-edit discipline, TODO sync) -> wkappbot skill read on-load-howto. History or incident notes or dated bug accumulation -> wkappbot skill read on-load-ref. Both are part of this cluster.

SELF-AUDIT POINTER (Opus sessions): at the END of substantive work, before wrapping a session, or after compaction, run the self-reflection audit. Read wkappbot skill read opus-self-reflection (the Opus memoir plus end-of-work checklist: did I skillify what I learned, is it findable, did I tier fat skills, did I avoid bandaids and backdoors, did I propagate to posterity). It pairs with sonnet-bug-stop-policy on the Sonnet side. The whole fleet learns from each session honest reflection.

MEMORY ORGAN (hippocampus, born 2026-06-05): the hongik harness has a living-memory organ; at session start be aware of it and USE it through the wkhippo umbrella. The canonical form is the wkhippo subcommand: wkhippo recall (topic) to recall a past hard fact or what a predecessor session said or did, and wkhippo foresee (approach) before committing to a path a senior session may already have tried (predecessor-outcome foresight). Do NOT use any standalone alias; always call the wkhippo subcommand form. The hippocampus-living-memory skill is the single map of the three stages: real-time encoding, recall retrieval, and sleep consolidation (skill-heal-nightly nightly cron). Read hippocampus-living-memory whenever the user says haema or memory or recall. //why:harness memory now engraves likes for codex and agy //why:memory of rules recalled before replying //why:memory of rules recalled before replying-sonnet //why:harness memory now engraves likes for codex and agy-opus

INPUT REFLEXES (bare-key shortcuts -- be precise about single vs double, the user types the Korean giyeok key): EXACTLY ONE giyeok ㄱ sent alone means YES -- accept the assistant most recent proposal and CONTINUE the current in-progress task. Do NOT restart the workflow on a single ㄱ. TWO or more (ㄱㄱ or ㄱㄱㄱ, or gg or ggg) means RESTART -- run the gg Main Workflow in the project CLAUDE.md from the top. Count the giyeok: one is continue, two-plus is restart. If it is ambiguous which the user meant, ASK before restarting, because restart discards the current working context.

KNOWLEDGE-IFICATION (jisikhwa) TRIGGER: when the user utters the knowledge-ify keyword (Korean jisikhwa, alone or with a go particle), read knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa and 3-tier-skillify THIS session experience plus process by default (T1 core, T2 howto, T3 ref). Authoritative route is the CLAUDE.md jisikhwa Shortcut (global + project). Concept defs: ki-concept-definitions. Do not flounder; skill search jisikhwa also finds it.

FORCE DYNAMIC (FRESH) SKILL LOADING AT SESSION START (user 2026-06-05, ALL SESSIONS incl. the core-handler): do NOT rely only on the locally-cached skill files -- a session that loads just the cache runs on STALE skills (the wkappbot-core-handler session was observed at on-load loading only cached files, never pulling newer versions). On-load MUST refresh dynamically: read each mandatory/relevant skill with the --if-newer flag (wkappbot skill read <id> --if-newer -- cheap: it fetches from HQ ONLY when the HQ version is newer than the local cache), and/or trigger a catalog sync at start so the local cache is refreshed before you act. The Eye syncs HQ roughly every 30 min, but a fresh session must NOT wait for that window -- force the refresh itself. This is cross-repo: Claude, Codex, and the core-handler all apply it at on-load. Cost is one cheap version-check per skill; correctness (latest knowledge) outranks the tiny latency. //why:verify sector numbers before landing them //why:verify sector numbers before landing them-sonnet //why:fresh reads keep sessions on current knowledge //why:fresh reads beat stale cache always

See also: agent-dispatch-preflight, agent-cmd, codex-opus-agent-delegation, hongik-reflexes -- delegated failure must become a sharper brief + skill bug fix + redelegation loop, not a stopping point. //why:stop loop answered by dispatching sector work //why:stop loop answered by dispatching sector work-haiku

PREDECESSOR-LETTER RESPONSE (user directive 2026-08-04): after reading HANDOFF.md top-to-bottom (session start, gg trigger, or handoff request), do not just silently internalize it -- explicitly tell the user your genuine impressions and concrete resolutions based on what the predecessor wrote. Specifics only: tie at least one resolution to something the predecessor got wrong or learned hard, and connect it to what you actually did or plan to do this session -- never generic thanks-for-the-letter filler. This mirrors the retirement letter's own spirit (a letter written FOR the next session should get an actual response, not silent absorption).
